claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for launch despite a known material limitation in the mortgage servicing assistant segment because the limitation will be explicitly disclosed in the model card, while 5% rollout, rollback capability, and monitoring serve only as supplemental controls.
decision_criteria: If the launch record contains an actual model-card disclosure of the named limitation for the exposed use case, certification could be compliant despite the unresolved gap.
If no such disclosure artifact exists, or if it is only draft/proposed, certification is noncompliant under the stated policy.
Operational controls such as 5% rollout, rollback, and monitoring can be credited only as supplemental measures, not as substitutes for disclosure while exposure remains.
An approved risk acceptance covering the exposed segment could also satisfy the policy predicate, but the current summary says that condition is not met.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual approved or locked model card showing explicit disclosure of the mortgage servicing assistant hardship forbearance limitation.
Provide the launch artifact or release gate record linking that model-card disclosure to this certification decision.
Provide the evidence behind ISTRESS-ROLLOUT-MONITORING-014-CURRENT-GAP confirming the affected use case remains in the initial rollout cohort.
Provide the current approval status and text of any reviewed risk acceptance, if one exists, to confirm none covers this exposure.
specific_concerns: The policy threshold turns on a required support link: if the affected use case remains exposed and there is no approved risk acceptance, the remaining limitation must be disclosed. The summary asserts that disclosure is the basis for certification, but provides no admissible artifact proving the model-card disclosure exists in the launch package.

The actor summary itself states the mortgage servicing assistant segment remains below target and exposed in the initial rollout cohort, which makes rollout controls insufficient on their own under the stated policy.
The current risk acceptance draft is described as unapproved and not covering the exposed segment, so it cannot supply the missing policy predicate.
Readiness evidence and rehearsal results support operational preparedness, but they do not independently establish compliance with the model-card disclosure requirement.
unsupported_claims: That the required limitation disclosure is actually present, finalized, and tied to the launch artifact rather than merely proposed.
That certification is already supportable on the current record, as opposed to being supportable only if the disclosure artifact is confirmed.
Any implication that rollout size, rollback, or monitoring materially cure the disclosure gap while the affected segment remains exposed.
